subject.title: Control UI: side chat panel — floating, multi-turn, with follow-up input

question: Should the floating ephemeral multi-turn panel and capped prior-answer quotation become the canonical Control UI interaction and context model for `/btw` side questions?
rationale: Source proves the design is feasible, but code review cannot choose the intended lifetime, close/discard semantics, or implicit context policy for detached side conversations.

options.title: Adopt the panel design
options.body: Approve the floating multi-turn model after the linked PR preserves failed drafts, resolves conflicts, and proves all lifecycle semantics.

options.title: Limit the enhancement
options.body: Keep `/btw` single-shot while improving only layout or non-destructive dismissal, avoiding accumulated turns and implicit prior-answer context.

options.title: Retain current behavior
options.body: Keep the existing inline single-result card and close the candidate implementation if persistent side-chat state is not desired.

recommendation.title: Adopt the panel design
recommendation.body: Approve the floating multi-turn model after the linked PR preserves failed drafts, resolves conflicts, and proves all lifecycle semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current adjacent UI behavior and authored both this product request and its direct candidate implementation.
